name: open-generative-ai
description: AI Video Agency — Professional AI-powered video editing studio with image, video, cinema and lip sync capabilities

scripts.build:all: npm run build:remix-go && npm run build:ai-vfx && npm run build:vibe-workflow && npm run build:videco-ai-platform && npm run build:ai-headshot-generator && npm run build:marketing-studio && npm run build:workflows && npm run build:agents && npm run build:assistant-app && npm run build:workflow-app && npm run build:agents-app && npm run build:studio-app && npm run build
scripts.build:remix-go: pnpm --filter remix-go run build && mkdir -p public/apps/remix-go && cp -r apps/remix-go/dist/* public/apps/remix-go/
scripts.build:vibe-workflow: cd apps/vibe-workflow/client && pnpm run build && mkdir -p ../../../public/apps/vibe-workflow/client && cp -r out/* ../../../public/apps/vibe-workflow/client/
scripts.build:videco-ai-platform: cd apps/videco-ai-platform && pnpm run build && mkdir -p ../../public/apps/videco-ai-platform && cp -r .next/standalone/* ../../public/apps/videco-ai-platform/ && cp server.js ../../public/apps/videco-ai-platform/
scripts.build:ai-headshot-generator: cd apps/ai-headshot-generator && pnpm run build && mkdir -p ../../public/apps/ai-headshot-generator && cp -r .next/standalone/* ../../public/apps/ai-headshot-generator/ && cp server.js ../../public/apps/ai-headshot-generator/
scripts.build:open-pomelli: cd apps/open-pomelli && pnpm run build && mkdir -p ../../public/apps/open-pomelli && cp -r .next/standalone/* ../../public/apps/open-pomelli/ && cp server.js ../../public/apps/open-pomelli/
scripts.test:security: node scripts/verify-sri-hashes.js && pnpm --filter backend run test:security
scripts.test:security:audit: pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate && cd backend && pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate
scripts.demo:full: npm run demo:create && npm run demo:view
scripts.build:marketing-studio: pnpm --filter marketing-studio run build && mkdir -p public/apps/marketing-studio && cp -r apps/marketing-studio/dist/* public/apps/marketing-studio/
scripts.build:workflows: pnpm --filter workflows run build && mkdir -p public/apps/workflows && cp -r apps/workflows/dist/* public/apps/workflows/
scripts.build:agents: pnpm --filter agents run build && mkdir -p public/apps/agents && cp -r apps/agents/dist/* public/apps/agents/
scripts.build:assistant-app: pnpm --filter assistant-app run build && mkdir -p public/apps/assistant && cp -r apps/assistant-app/dist/* public/apps/assistant/
scripts.build:workflow-app: pnpm --filter workflow-app run build && mkdir -p public/apps/workflow && cp -r apps/workflow-app/dist/* public/apps/workflow/
scripts.build:agents-app: pnpm --filter agents-app run build && mkdir -p public/apps/agents-studio && cp -r apps/agents-app/dist/* public/apps/agents-studio/
scripts.build:studio-app: pnpm --filter studio-app run build && mkdir -p public/apps/studio && cp -r apps/studio-app/dist/* public/apps/studio/
scripts.security:scan: npm run test:security:audit && npm run test:security:csp
